listing.title: Linux System Administration Handbook + Prompt Engineering Guide - 2 Book Bundle
listing.description: Two technical books. The first covers system prompts, shell instructions, and how to override default configuration safely. The second is an introduction to prompt design for language models, including a chapter on prompt injection and how developers defend against it.
